evidence.snippet: return DOMPurify.sanitize(rawHtml, { ALLOWED_TAGS, ALLOWED_ATTR, ALLOW_DATA_ATTR: false });
evidence.why: Markdown-derived HTML is sanitized with a real sanitiser and explicit allowlist before use.
innerHTML is used but only on an already-sanitized string, and the detached node's children are moved via replaceChildren rather than re-parsing in the live DOM via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

controls_present: server-only sanitisation module separated from client rendering
